"""Official Blender MCP host only: one frame of an unchanged inspection movie."""
import bpy, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('<task-root>/seismic-ecosystem-recovery/poster-v2')
settings=json.loads((ROOT/'inputs.json').read_text())
source=Path(settings['source']); output=ROOT/'native-poster.png'; receipt=ROOT/'native-readback.json'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(source)==settings['source_sha256'] and source.stat().st_size==88406
assert not output.exists() and not receipt.exists()
def memory():
    return {line.split(':')[0]+'_KiB':int(line.split()[1]) for line in Path('/proc/self/status').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith(('VmRSS:','VmHWM:'))}
before=memory()
original=bpy.context.scene; original_frame=original.frame_current; scene=None; clip=None
try:
    clip=bpy.data.movieclips.load(str(source),check_existing=False)
    assert clip.frame_duration==120 and list(clip.size)==[1178,814]
    bpy.data.movieclips.remove(clip); clip=None
    scene=bpy.data.scenes.new('Seismic_Observation_Poster_Only')
    scene.render.engine='BLENDER_WORKBENCH'
    scene.render.resolution_x=1178; scene.render.resolution_y=814; scene.render.resolution_percentage=100
    scene.render.pixel_aspect_x=1; scene.render.pixel_aspect_y=1
    scene.render.fps=15; scene.render.fps_base=1; scene.frame_start=1; scene.frame_end=120
    scene.render.use_sequencer=True
    scene.view_settings.view_transform='Standard'; scene.view_settings.look='None'
    scene.view_settings.exposure=0; scene.view_settings.gamma=1; scene.display_settings.display_device='sRGB'
    scene.render.image_settings.file_format='PNG'; scene.render.image_settings.color_mode='RGB'; scene.render.image_settings.color_depth='8'
    scene.render.filepath=str(output)
    editor=scene.sequence_editor_create(); strips=getattr(editor,'strips',None)
    if strips is None: strips=editor.sequences
    strip=strips.new_movie('Original_Continuous_Window_Observation',str(source),channel=1,frame_start=1)
    assert strip.frame_final_duration==120
    strip.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB'
    scene.frame_set(120)
    # Blender scene= copies the current context frame into its target scene.
    # Override the actual context instead and leave the original scene/frame alone.
    with bpy.context.temp_override(scene=scene,view_layer=scene.view_layers[0]):
        assert bpy.context.scene==scene and scene.frame_current==120
        result=bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
        assert scene.frame_current==120
    assert bpy.context.scene==original and original.frame_current==original_frame
    assert result=={'FINISHED'} and output.is_file() and sha(source)==settings['source_sha256']
    receipt.write_text(json.dumps({'source_sha256':sha(source),'output_sha256':sha(output),'source_frame_zero_based':119,'scene_frame':scene.frame_current,'original_scene_frame_unchanged':original.frame_current==original_frame,'dimensions':[1178,814],'color':'display sRGB / Standard / None / exposure0 / gamma1','scope':'Single poster of unchanged native-window observation, not new ParaView artwork or original authoring replay','source_unchanged':True,'host_version':bpy.app.version_string,'memory_before':before,'memory_after_encoding':memory(),'memory_scope':'Before/after RSS only; VmHWM is historical process high-water mark, not measured extraction peak'},indent=2))
finally:
    if clip is not None:bpy.data.movieclips.remove(clip)
    if bpy.context.window:bpy.context.window.scene=original
    if scene is not None:bpy.data.scenes.remove(scene)
    assert bpy.context.scene==original and original.frame_current==original_frame
